correctness.rationale: PASS: GF(8) with x³+x+1 and P={0,1,2} has 56 affine translates, representing every triple. Exactly 10 affine disjointness generators form the displayed 10-cycle. Direct independent GF(8) construction checks all 1120 directed darts and finds 280 distinct simple four-cycle facial orbits, connected graph V=112,E=560; Euler yields g=85. Graph is bridgeless, simple, bipartite, so every orientable cellular face has length at least four; F≤E/2=280 gives g≥85. Swapping class and affine translations establishes vertex transitivity. This is a complete finite certificate for exactly H(8,3), not an infinite approximation.
